decisions.evidence: Howard et al., arXiv:1810.08240v9 p.5, Definition 1 (PDF page index 4, lines 239–247) defines the sub-psi condition, not test supermartingales. Removed that inaccurate reference; retained Ramdas et al., arXiv:2210.01948 §§2.2–2.4, printed p.5, which supplies the common-law supermartingale class and distinction from e-processes. Its M0=1 convention is stricter than this item’s explicitly stated initial-expectation convention; the latter is sound and directly proved sufficient by the local Ville argument. Definition and dependencies unchanged.
